hero.subtitle: Health assets map
hero.lead: The Health Assets Map is a tool that identifies and highlights the resources in Finestrat that contribute to the well-being of the population. Through a participatory process, both existing assets and opportunities for improvement have been identified to enhance access and use.
hero.emphBefore: This map helps people discover the spaces, services and initiatives that support physical, mental and social health. It is an invitation to explore them, integrate them into your daily life and continue moving towards a healthier and more inclusive Finestrat.
hero.emphStrong: Make the most of your municipality’s health assets.

map.header: Health assets map and citizen perception for community health promotion

footer.text: This project has been funded by the Department of Health of the Generalitat Valenciana under the call for projects for the implementation of the Community Health Plan. The content of this publication is the sole responsibility of Finestrat Town Council.
